item.title: KDDI Builds Trustworthy Consumer AI
item.summary: KDDI is enhancing its approach to consumer AI through Buffmee, a conversational search and study assistant that prioritizes accuracy, reliability, and trustworthiness over broad internet searches. According to GlobalData, Buffmee illustrates how a telecommunications company can make consumer-generated AI feel more accountable by restricting its references to a curated set of reliable sources.
